name: JRC Global Surface Water Dynamics Dataset
description: Developed by the European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC) in partnership with Google Earth Engine, the JRC Global Surface Water dataset maps the location, temporal persistence, and long-term changes of surface water over a 38-year period (1984–present) at 30-meter resolution globally. Generated from more than 4.5 million Landsat satellite scenes using automated expert systems, the dataset delivers six core thematic layers: Water Occurrence, Occurrence Change Intensity, Water Seasonality, Water Recurrence, Water Transitions, and Maximum Water Extent.
